title: apcore Registry.export_schema Envelope
description: The exact object `Registry.export_schema(module_id, strict)` returns. Four keys, no more: this is a schema export, not a module manifest. Descriptor metadata (name, version, tags, annotations, examples, documentation, source_path, dependencies) belongs to `system.manifest.module`, which sys-manifest-module.schema.json already defines — an export that carries a subset of those fields is a third shape that matches neither contract.

module_id.description: Canonical ID of the exported module, as registered.

description.description: The module's one-line description, copied from its descriptor.

input_schema.description: The module's input JSON Schema. When `strict` is true this is the Algorithm A23 conversion of it. Any `$defs` the schema uses stay inside this object where JSON Schema puts them — there is deliberately no sibling `definitions` key, which would be a second, always-empty place to look.

output_schema.description: The module's output JSON Schema, under the same `strict` rule as input_schema.
